parallels.note: Into whatever house you enter, stay there, and depart from there.

translations.web: He said to them, “Wherever you enter into a house, stay there until you depart from there.
translations.bsb: And He told them, “When you enter a house, stay there until you leave that area.
translations.kjv: And he said unto them, In what place soever ye enter into an house, there abide till ye depart from that place.
translations.asv: And he said unto them, Wheresoever ye enter into a house, there abide till ye depart thence.
